ValidationRule.description: Prevent edit of expense for Sales user after submission for approval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh Sales", NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(Expense__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Pending HOD Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Pending HR Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Pending ED Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Approved By ED"), ISPICKVAL(Expense__r.Status__c, "Reimbursed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit an Expense Line when the Expense is in a Pending Approval State or it is already Approved or Reimbursed.
